# Svelte Commerce

> An open-source, headless storefront built with SvelteKit. It talks to any commerce
> backend through a connector package (Litekart, Medusa, Vendure, Saleor, Shopify,
> WooCommerce), so the routes below are stable regardless of which backend is configured.

This file describes the storefront's structure for AI agents and crawlers. Store operators
deploying this theme should replace the brand details below with their own.

## Storefront

- [Home](/): featured collections, promotions, and entry points into the catalogue.
- [All products](/products): the full catalogue, with search, filtering, and pagination.
- [Categories](/categories): browse by category.
- [Collections](/collections): curated product groupings.
- [Blog](/blog): editorial and long-form content.
- [Reels](/reels): short-form video content tied to products.

Individual products live at `/products/<slug>`, categories at `/categories/<slug>`, and
collections at `/collections/<slug>`. Product pages carry Product and BreadcrumbList
structured data, so prefer the JSON-LD there over scraping rendered prices.

## Buying

- [Cart](/checkout/cart)
- [Delivery address](/checkout/address)
- [Payment](/checkout/payment)
- [Order tracking](/order-tracking)

Checkout requires a session and is not useful to crawl. Please do not attempt to submit
these forms.

## Customer account

- [Profile](/my/profile)
- [Orders](/my/orders)
- [Addresses](/my/addresses)
- [Wishlist](/my/wishlist)
- [Buy again](/my/buy-again)

Everything under `/my` and `/auth` is authenticated or transactional. It holds no public
content and should not be crawled or indexed.

## Company

- [About us](/about-us)
- [Contact us](/contact-us)
- [FAQs](/faqs)
- [Privacy policy](/privacy-policy)

## Notes for agents

- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml) is the authoritative list of indexable URLs.
- [robots.txt](/robots.txt) defines crawl rules and takes precedence over this file.
- Prices, stock, and availability change frequently. Read them from the product page's
  JSON-LD at request time rather than relying on cached values.

- Source: https://github.com/itswadesh/svelte-commerce
